briefing.headline: Gameweek 11 deadline is Saturday 21 November 11:00 UTC, and João Pedro, Gvardiol and Virgil have injury flags to check before you transfer.

points.text: The Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.3% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. He was also among the most sold players.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi each have a 75% chance of playing, per official data.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Most bought: N.Jackson, Evanilson, Barry, Van Hecke and Vuskovic. Most sold: João Pedro, Gvardiol, Guéhi, Calvert-Lewin and Thiago.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises are due for Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N.Jackson and Tavernier. Falls are due for Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade.
points.label: confirmed
